learningObjectives: Differentiate reward prediction, pleasure, motivation and habit.
Explain reward prediction error and dopaminergic learning.
Identify ventral versus dorsal striatal contributions.
Apply reward mechanisms to anhedonia, addiction and behaviour change.

anatomy.label: Ventral tegmental area
anatomy.detail: Midbrain dopamine neurons signal better- or worse-than-expected outcomes.
anatomy.clinical: Altered signalling can impair learning or amplify cue-driven motivation.

anatomy.label: Nucleus accumbens
anatomy.detail: Combines reward predictions with current physiological and contextual state.
anatomy.clinical: Cue sensitisation may drive compulsive approach.

anatomy.label: Orbitofrontal cortex
anatomy.detail: Tracks the current value and identity of expected outcomes.
anatomy.clinical: Damage can cause poor reversal learning and inflexible choice.

anatomy.label: Dorsal striatum
anatomy.detail: Links contexts and actions through repeated reinforcement.
anatomy.clinical: Overlearned habits may persist despite changing goals.

anatomy.label: Habenula
anatomy.detail: Contributes to aversive prediction and suppression of unrewarded actions.
anatomy.clinical: Excessive negative-outcome signalling may relate to pessimistic learning.

stages.label: Predict
stages.text: The brain estimates likely value before acting.

stages.label: Act
stages.text: Effort is allocated toward a selected option.

stages.label: Compare
stages.text: Prediction error signals better- or worse-than-expected results.

stages.label: Update
stages.text: Future value and action policies are revised.

quizBank.explanation: Dopamine supports prediction error, incentive salience and action vigour.

quizBank.question: Reward prediction error is the difference between:
quizBank.explanation: Prediction error updates future value estimates.

quizBank.question: The ventral striatum is especially important for:
quizBank.explanation: Ventral striatal circuits link predicted value to motivated behaviour.

quizBank.question: Habits rely increasingly on:
quizBank.explanation: Repeated reinforcement shifts behaviour toward dorsal striatal stimulus-response control.

quizBank.question: Anhedonia always means dopamine is absent.
quizBank.explanation: Anhedonia is heterogeneous and can involve valuation, motivation, learning or consummatory pleasure.
